name: Bulk Product Commander
author: Tylon Pake

sections.description:
Bulk Product Commander lets you manage your WooCommerce products like a boss.

Easily export all product data (including custom meta fields), make changes in your favorite spreadsheet tool, and import them back without touching individual product pages.

Whether you’re editing 10 products or 10,000, BPC saves you hours of tedious clicking.

Highlights:
– One-click CSV export of all WooCommerce products (including variations)
– Import updated CSVs to apply changes in bulk
– Inline AJAX editing of product fields directly in the admin grid
– Custom meta field support for advanced stores
– Automatic backups before every import or inline edit

No fluff. Just bulk editing done right.

Features

Core Features

  • Export products with standard fields: price, weight, dimensions, stock, and more
  • Include custom meta fields (configurable)
  • Supports both simple and variable products
  • Inline admin editor with real-time AJAX updates
  • CSV import with smart field mapping
  • Change log and auto-backup of product data on every action

Built for Power Users

  • Uses WooCommerce core APIs for stability
  • Works with large product catalogs efficiently
  • Fully translation-ready and secure with nonce/auth checks
  • Compatible with most WooCommerce extensions

Source Code

This plugin includes third-party libraries:

  • Tablesorter by Mottie — MIT licensed
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/bulk-product-commander, or install via WordPress Admin → Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Go to Bulk Product Commander to begin editing.
sections.faq:
Can I include custom fields in the export/import?

Yes! You can define custom meta fields from the settings page, and they will be included in your CSV.

Is it safe to use on a live store?

Absolutely. BPC makes a full CSV backup of your products before any import or inline edit.

Does this support product variations?

Yes – variations are fully supported, including separate SKUs and pricing.

What happens if I mess up an import?

Don’t panic — you can revert using the auto-generated backup CSV.

Is this translation-ready?

Yes, all strings use standard WordPress internationalization functions and the plugin includes a Text Domain.
